summary: IEC-104 module is the T2/T3 leader in this tranche. STARTDT accepted without auth is T2 (proves data-transfer gate open). General Interrogation returning the full process image with real IOAs and values is T2 (proof of unauth process-state read). Session-singleton hijack is T2 (proves legit master can be displaced). Under --iec104-write flag, clock-sync and reset-process writes are T3 (actual writes to the outstation). CAA enumeration finds multi-substation gateways. Solid vendor fingerprint from private TypeIDs.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 SCADA device on the scanned network
findings.tier_evidence: APCI 0x68 + length + valid U/S/I control field is deterministic IEC-104 fingerprint.
findings.promotion_notes: Stance; iec104_startdt_accepted is the T2 counterpart.
findings.tester_next_step: printf '\x68\x04\x43\x00\x00\x00' | nc <ip> 2404 | xxd (TESTFR act); nmap --script iec-identify -p 2404 <ip>.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 accepts STARTDT with no authentication
findings.tier_evidence: STARTDT con (U-format ctl1=0x0B) returned to unauthenticated STARTDT act — data-transfer state opened without a credential.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 (destructive) = issue Single Command (TypeID 45) to a real IOA — trips breakers. Gated behind --iec104-write, and even then never blindly.
findings.tester_next_step: TEST-CELL ONLY: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 single-command --caa 1 --ioa <known_test_ioa> --on. NEVER on live substations.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 General Interrogation returned the full process image
findings.tier_evidence: C_IC_NA_1 returned actual TypeID/IOA/value tuples for M_SP/M_DP/M_ME points — proof of unauth live process-state read, not stance.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = long-running monitoring / SOE capture to reveal operational rhythm; or actuation via C_SC_NA_1 to any enumerated IOA (destructive).
findings.tester_next_step: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 interrogation --caa <caa> --for 60 (log all telemetry for 60s); identify high-value IOAs (breakers/isolators) by IOA range convention (per site).

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 additional Common ASDU Addresses reachable behind the gateway
findings.tier_evidence: Multiple CAAs returning non-'unknown-CA' COT proves gateway fronts multiple substations.
findings.promotion_notes: Run general interrogation per CAA to enumerate each substation's process image (already handled by primary iteration but limited to 32 IOAs).
findings.tester_next_step: For each caa in caa_alive: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 interrogation --caa <caa> --limit 1000 — reveals each substation's full point list.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 control write types reachable — unauthenticated actuation of physical equipment
findings.tier_evidence: Emitted whenever startdt_ok — the surface is confirmed but the writes are NOT sent by recce. T1 (surface proven), not T2 (write proven).
findings.promotion_notes: T2 evidence is provided by iec104_clock_writable / iec104_reset_writable when --iec104-write is set.
findings.tester_next_step: TEST-CELL ONLY: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 single-command --caa 1 --ioa <ioa> --on; observe the corresponding M_SP change in the next interrogation. Never on production.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 clock synchronisation (C_CS_NA_1) writable — SOE forensic integrity at risk
findings.tier_evidence: C_CS_NA_1 with CP56Time2a was ACT-CONFIRMED (COT=7, P/N=0) — the outstation's real-time clock was actually written by an unauth session.
findings.promotion_notes: T4 = drift-attack chain — walk the clock backwards to bury a specific event's SOE timestamp among noise, defeating post-incident forensics. Combined with control writes = full grid-manipulation chain.
findings.tester_next_step: TEST-CELL ONLY: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 clock-sync --caa <caa> --time '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z' (or drifted); verify the RTU's SOE timestamps now diverge from grid time.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 Reset Process (C_RP_NA_1) reachable — unauthenticated remote RTU reboot
findings.tier_evidence: C_RP_NA_1 QRP=1 acknowledged — the outstation was actually reset from an unauth session.
findings.promotion_notes: T4 chain: reset in a loop while sending fake events during boot windows → operational blindness.
findings.tester_next_step: TEST-CELL ONLY: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 reset --caa <caa>; verify all points drop for the boot cycle. NEVER on production.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 transported in cleartext (no IEC 62351-3 TLS)
findings.tier_evidence: TLS ClientHello did not complete handshake — deterministic cleartext posture.
findings.tester_next_step: tcpdump -w /tmp/104.pcap 'host <ip> and port 2404'; capture a legit master session to prove interrogation/control content is readable on the wire.

findings.tier_evidence: TLS handshake completed — good posture indicator.
findings.promotion_notes: Add mutual-auth check — attempt handshake without client cert; if it succeeds, TLS is 'in name only' (T1 finding).
findings.tester_next_step: openssl s_client -connect <ip>:2404 -showcerts (no client cert); if it completes, the peer accepts any client — IEC 62351-3 §5 mutual auth is not enforced.

findings.tier_evidence: Private-range TypeID pattern maps to vendor family — passive fingerprint.
findings.promotion_notes: Expand _vendor_hint mapping and add per-vendor CVE cross-reference; e.g. Siemens SICAM CVEs, ABB RTU5xx CVEs.
findings.tester_next_step: Correlate against Siemens/ABB/GE/SEL/Schneider IEC-104 advisories; check the RTU's web UI on 80/443 for default creds (SICAM: admin/100, RTU5xx: admin/admin).

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 targeted per-IOA read succeeded without authentication
findings.tier_evidence: C_RD_NA_1 returned a real value for the requested IOA — proof of per-object read primitive.
findings.promotion_notes: T2 is the ceiling of read primitives.
findings.tester_next_step: iec104ctl <ip>:2404 read --caa <caa> --ioa <n>; loop over the IOA-list from interrogation for continuous per-object monitoring.

findings.title_pattern: IEC-104 session singleton: legitimate master can be forcibly displaced
findings.tier_evidence: Second STARTDT succeeded AND first session was torn down — proof of displacing hijack primitive.
findings.promotion_notes: T3 = maintain the hijack while sending forged data on the displaced master's slot; requires the legitimate master's source IP to be spoofable (or reachable from the tester).
findings.tester_next_step: LAB ONLY: open two concurrent iec104ctl sessions; while the second is live, issue interrogation/control from it while the operator's HMI sees connection drop then reconnect. Never on production.
